messages:
riya: Heads up — noticed ~2k new HubSpot accounts in the last 24h created by `onboard-webhook`. A bunch look like duplicates (email+company variations). Dedupe merge jobs are failing on the third retry. Can we design a short "cleanroom" sync ruleset to stop new dup writes and queue a backfill?

jonah: Ugh. Is the failure rate 5xx from the merge service or validation rejects? Any sample rows?

riya: Mostly validation rejects. Example rows: `bob@acme.com` vs `bob.j@acme.com`, company `Acme` vs `Acme, Inc.`. Some accounts have missing lifecycle stage. Quick sample CSV: 
```
email,company,created_at,source
bob@acme.com,Acme,2026-06-10T11:12:00Z,onboard-webhook
bob.j@acme.com,Acme,2026-06-10T11:12:05Z,onboard-webhook
sally+trial@globex.com,Globex,2026-06-10T12:01:10Z,manual-import
```

We need a ruleset to: 1) normalize company names (strip punctuation + common suffixes), 2) canonicalize emails (strip aliasing +/-), 3) hold conflicting creates into a dedupe queue instead of creating new HS records, 4) mark inbound records with `source_tag=onboard-queue` for safe backfill.

priya: Agree. Suggestion for quick dedupe pseudocode: 
```
# on inbound
email_key = normalize_email(payload.email)
company_key = normalize_company(payload.company)
existing = find_account_by_email_or_company(email_key, company_key)
if existing and merge_safe(existing, payload): merge(existing, payload)
else: enqueue_for_manual_review(payload, tag='onboard-queue')
```

liam: Important note: if we hold too many creates, renewal managers might not see accounts in playbooks. Can we set a TTL on queued items (e.g., auto-escalate after 6h) and surface them in the Healthscore queue so AMs have visibility?

riya: Yes — plan is: queued items get `onboard_hold` boolean and appear in CS console under "Pending accounts" with a warning icon. TTL 6h to auto-assign to backlog owner. Also add healthscore impact: `onboard_hold` should reduce healthscore by -10 until resolved so renewals don't get false positives.

ops-bot: webhook-retry-monitor: 37 failures for `onboard-merge` in last 1h. Last error: `validation_failed: ambiguous_merge_key`

jonah: Can ops team add a short-term routing rule to send `onboard-webhook` to the safe queue while we ship ruleset? That will reduce churn and stop writes to HS for uncertain merges.

priya: I can draft the ruleset and a small SQL to find likely duplicates for manual triage. Draft SQL to seed review queue: 
```
SELECT a.id, a.email, a.company, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(regexp_replace(email, '\\+.*@', '@'))) as email_group
FROM staging.accounts a
WHERE source = 'onboard-webhook'
AND created_at > now() - interval '2 days'
ORDER BY email_group DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

riya: Nice. Who will own the safe-queue routing change? Jonah/ops? Also need a communication note to AMs and onboarding CS so they know to check "Pending accounts".

jonah: I can make the routing change — will open an infra changelist and tag it `cs-onboard-safe-queue`. ETA 2h.

priya: I'll drop the ruleset PR into `csops/configs` and include the normalizers list (company suffix map + email normalization). Will also add tests for alias stripping and common suffixes.

liam: I'll notify the renewal managers via the `renewals` channel with a short blurb explaining `onboard_hold` and the -10 healthscore behavior.

riya: Agree on next steps:
- Jonah: route `onboard-webhook` -> `safe-onboard-queue` (ops) (due in 2h)
- Priya: PR ruleset + SQL backfill script (due EOD)
- Riya: create short AM note + update CS console note (due today)

riya: Quick question for the backfill script — do we re-run merge attempts automatically after ruleset merges? I'd prefer an idempotent merge job that runs every hour for queued items marked `auto_retry=true`.

priya: Yep, implement `auto_retry` with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts, then mark for manual review. We'll test on a small slice first.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started routing change `cs-onboard-safe-queue` by jonah — status: in-progress

riya: Thanks all. I'll log this thread into the CS ops runbook under "crm-cleanroom" and link the PRs. Please react with :thumbsup: when done so I can close the loop.

jonah: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:
